name: templates-live-reload
body: Templates live reload: while `kalide start` runs, changes to the RESOLVED library LAYERS' structure — each layer's `library.yaml` and anything under its `slides/`, `sections/`, `themes/` and `media/` (the external library at the configured `templates:` path when set, and the deck-root `templates/` directory when it exists; see layered-template-library, templates-dir-layout) — are detected like deck changes; the changed layer is re-validated, the layers merged, templates/themes reloaded, the deck re-validated and re-rendered, and the browser reloads (or shows the full-page templates error). The scope is each resolved layer's structure only — any other top-level entry in a layer root (e.g. `.git/`, a README) is not part of the library and is ignored (templates-dir-layout). A change to the configured `templates:` value itself in `kalide.yaml` is not a live retarget: it stops serving and shows the full-page restart-required error (see template-retarget-requires-restart).
